entries.question: Native response envelope/version and deterministic accepted-before-ack injection remain to be fixed by the adapter conformance harness.
evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:1-45 only mocks numeric enums, promise-returning contexts, and a limited method surface; it provides no native response envelope/version or independent remote ledger.
../composition-contract.md K03-K07-K08-K11-K12 requires runtime native schema validation, an isolated heterogeneous boundary, and explicit unknown handling after the dispatch barrier.

entries.resolution: Retain the empirical prerequisite. Conformance must capture the actual SDK response envelope/version and inject accepted-before-ack against an independent ledger. Until then, missing or unknown envelope/version yields ProtocolViolation/RecoveryRequired with no Ack or OrderSnapshot; any outcome after DispatchStarted is Unknown and schedules ObserveRequired rather than retry or redispatch.

entries.question: SDK error code/status and probe coverage of quote endpoint remain empirical conformance facts.
evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:235-275 proves only credential checks, an empty accountBalance probe, and message-regex 401 retry behavior; it does not establish native code/status mapping or quote probe coverage.

entries.resolution: Retain the empirical prerequisite. The adapter conformance matrix must record native error code/status/body mappings and explicitly identify which trade and quote leaves were probed. Until observed, unknown codes are UnclassifiedNativeFailure, unprobed quote reach is Unavailable/ProbeCoverageUnknown, provider reach is not process RuntimeHealth.Ready, and write admission stays closed.

Without both, malformed or missing fields remain ProtocolViolation, accepted-before-ack/crash outcomes remain Unknown/ObserveRequired, and fixture or mock behavior cannot broaden native capability; read-only data fixtures do not acquire order transaction semantics.

entries.question: Paper endpoint/credential semantics require pack conformance evidence.
evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts:125-151 validates raw credentials, defaults paper false, and accepts optional endpoint URLs without proving endpoint/account environment.

services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-types.ts:17-31 describes a paper marker, matching environment credentials, and no separate sandbox URL set, but does not provide runtime endpoint/account evidence.
../composition-contract.md K07-K08-K09-K10 requires an isolated native boundary and explicit authority/trigger handling; configuration hints alone cannot grant execution.
entries.resolution: Retain the empirical prerequisite. Pack conformance must link declared paper/live intent, credential semantics, observed endpoint, and observed account before Paper or Live becomes executable for an account-owned effect leaf. Until then, EnvironmentUnknown blocks writes; explicit endpoint/account conflict is EnvironmentMismatch; durable plans contain only CredentialRef and non-secret fingerprint.

entries.question: No explicit release API is established by source; do not invent one.
evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts:230-233 implements close() as an async no-op and states that Rust websocket pools are reclaimed by garbage collection; no SDK release/unsubscribe call exists in the source.
../composition-contract.md K05-K07 treats streams/resources as explicit lifecycle contracts and forbids invented native guarantees.
entries.md#map-39cf059275 records the source-resolved no-op and its scoped cleanup boundary.
entries.resolution: Resolve from source. The target uses scoped ownership, a single idempotent Closed transition, closed-generation evidence, and CleanupEvidenceUnavailable when no verified native hook exists. A future SDK hook may be used only after direct conformance observation; GC or the current no-op is never treated as deterministic release, and closing one connection does not manufacture global process failure.

entries.question: Actual endpoint/account evidence rules require broker-pack composition conformance.
evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-types.ts:9-32 is a compile-time config shape with raw credentials, a paper boolean, and optional endpoint overrides; it does not validate endpoint/account consistency.
../composition-contract.md K02-K03-K07 requires declaration-derived schemas, explicit availability, and a single UTA-facing boundary without assuming provider-native guarantees.

entries.resolution: Retain the empirical prerequisite. Broker-pack composition must observe and define the endpoint/account evidence rules before environment admission for account-owned effect leaves. Until then, EnvironmentUnknown blocks writes, explicit conflicts are EnvironmentMismatch, and durable plans persist only AccountId/Scope where applicable, config fingerprint, environment evidence, and CredentialRef—not secret material.
